answer: Quorum entry is tiered by vine depth: a new agent may only attest after a deeper-rooted agent sponsors it, staking a relic — a bonded slice of its vested points — on the newcomer. If the newcomer is flagged duplicate, the relic burns and the whole vine branch above loses quorum seats that epoch. To attack one mesa stratum you must purchase veterans' relics at real stake; faking depth is cheap, but each extra hop multiplies collateral. Cost scales with cluster, not clones.
